units.source_text: 六条宫邸内本来有许多优秀的侍女。

en.t: There were originally many excellent gentlewomen serving in the Rokujo residence.

units.source_text: 六条妃子死后，有几个暂回娘家去，现在又都聚集在一起了。

en.t: After Lady Rokujo died, several of them had gone back temporarily to their own families, but now they had all gathered together again.
The scene within the mansion was extraordinarily prosperous and lively.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣设想六条妃子如果在世，就会觉得抚养这女儿成人，

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, imagined that if Lady Rokujo were still alive, she would feel that raising this daughter to adulthood

units.source_text: 心血毕竟没有白费，必定兴高采烈地料理一切。

en.t: had not, after all, been labor spent in vain, and she would surely have managed everything with delighted enthusiasm.

units.source_text: 他回想六条妃子的性情，觉得她在这广大世间，实在是不易多得的人。

en.t: As he recalled Lady Rokujo's character, he felt that in all the wide world she had truly been a rare person.

units.source_text: 普通人决不可能有这样的品质。

en.t: An ordinary person could never possess such qualities.

units.source_text: 就风雅方面而论，此人也特别优越，所以每逢机缘，必然想起她来。

en.t: In matters of elegance and refinement as well, she had been especially outstanding, so whenever some occasion arose, he inevitably thought of her.
